width = 0.35

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax2.set_ylabel('Values')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity and Daily Steps by Occupation')

ax2.legend()

ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category')

ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='BP Value', hue='BP Type', data=bp_data, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure Distribution by BMI Category')
ax4.legend(title='BP Type')

ax5.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics')

# 6. Heart Rate vs Age (scatter with regression)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])

ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Age with Regression Line')

ax7.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax7.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
ax7.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Occupation')

ax8.set_xlabel('Occupation')

# Normalize values for radar chart

for col in normalized_data.columns:

# Plot each person
for idx, row in normalized_data.iterrows():
    values = row.values.tolist()
    values += values[:1]
    ax9.plot(angles, values, linewidth=2, linestyle='solid', label=f'Person {idx+1}')
    ax9.fill(angles, values, alpha=0.1)

ax9.set_xticks(angles[:-1])
ax9.set_xticklabels(categories)
ax9.set_title('Health Metrics Radar Chart')
